description: CloudSpace es un equipo multidisciplinario integrado por ingenieros en Tecnologías de la Información y una Licenciada en Enfermería. Unimos la precisión de la arquitectura de software con la perspicacia del cuidado clínico para resolver el desafío de Crear software para monitorear la salud de astronautas en misiones espaciales. Nuestra iniciativa propone diagnósticos predictivos y oportunos en tiempo real, aplicables para proteger la vida humana en el espacio para la innovación tecnológica.
summary: S.O.F.I.A. is short for Super-Intelligent Operated First Infirmary Assistant. This system is designed for aiding and as a companion for astronauts during their launch, mission, and reentry. It's not only an digital nurse for monitoring vitals, health parameters and other medical data, through super-inteligence and machine learning, it is aware of the astronaut's context as well as the mission. It's primary directive is to aid and assist astronauts on their mission.
details:
Our app is made for the medical aid and assistance of astronauts and their mission. We design our app to work in a variety of enviroments, devices and linked to medical hardware, have the ability to keep real time data online and checked for each user.

S.O.F.I.A. is designed to be the first line of monitoring and provide advice on a case by case basis. Our medical assistant is loaded with super-intelligence so it keeps learning context from the mission and from each astronaut.

We used a variety of technologies in our stack, focusing on React.JS for the frontend so it can run on multidevices without compromising compatability.

Our project looks beyond a simple medical assitance, to include a human factor, even in the vacuum of space. Thinking ahead, the Legacy Protocol was design to acompany an asotronaut even if his life is in danger, or a rescue not possible, S.O.F.I.A. will be there to record a message from the astronaut and keep all the data for future scientific study to help us better understand what happens to us in a differnet environment.
